title: The Flood Recedes

questions.question: Which bird did Noah send out first?
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:7: Noah first sent out a raven.

questions.question: What did the dove bring back to Noah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:11: The dove returned with a freshly plucked olive leaf.

questions.question: What was the first thing Noah built after leaving the ark?
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:20: Noah built an altar to the LORD.

questions.question: On which mountain did the ark come to rest?
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:4: The ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

questions.question: What did Noah offer on the altar?
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:20: Noah offered burnt offerings from every clean animal and bird.

questions.question: How did God cause the flood waters to recede?
options: A wind blew over the earth
questions.correctAnswer: A wind blew over the earth
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:1: God made a wind blow over the earth and the waters subsided.

questions.question: What happened when Noah sent out the dove the third time?
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:12: The dove did not return to him anymore.

questions.question: What did God promise never to do again after the flood?
options: Curse the ground because of man
questions.correctAnswer: Curse the ground because of man
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:21: "I will never again curse the ground because of man."

questions.question: What did God say would never cease while the earth remains?
options: Seedtime, harvest, cold, heat, summer, winter, day, night
questions.correctAnswer: Seedtime, harvest, cold, heat, summer, winter, day, night
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:22: "seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night, shall not cease."

questions.question: How long did Noah wait between sending out the dove the second time?
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:10: Noah waited another seven days before sending the dove again.

questions.question: In what month did the ark rest on Ararat?
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:4: The ark rested on Ararat in the seventh month.

questions.question: When did the tops of the mountains become visible?
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:5: On the first day of the tenth month, the tops of the mountains were seen.

questions.question: How long after the flood started did Noah remove the covering of the ark?
options: 301 days (first day of first month in 601st year)
questions.correctAnswer: 301 days (first day of first month in 601st year)
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:13: In the 601st year, first month, first day, Noah removed the covering.

questions.question: What did God smell from Noah's sacrifice?
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:21: "the LORD smelled the pleasing aroma."

questions.question: What reason did God give for not cursing the ground again?
options: The intention of man's heart is evil from youth
questions.correctAnswer: The intention of man's heart is evil from youth
questions.explanation: Genesis 8:21: God showed mercy despite man's evil nature from youth.

key_verse_text: While the earth remains, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night, shall not cease.
